recovery.strategy: Reuse the evolved setup runtime already present in authoritative composition; do not replay the stale historical runtime snapshot.

laravel_adaptation.route: GET /setup is explicitly registered by SetupRouteServiceProvider under web middleware only and resolves to SetupReadController.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_neutral_boundary: The first-run read accepts no route parameters and deliberately has neither auth nor tenant.context middleware, matching tenant-neutral installation semantics.
laravel_adaptation.read_model: DatabaseSetupReadService checks the configured database connection, repository migration ledger completeness, and first identity readiness; failures remain incomplete and fail closed.
laravel_adaptation.rendering: DatabaseSetupPageService renders bounded operator-safe status through Blade while database/provider credentials remain deployment-owned and never enter the page model.
laravel_adaptation.completion_redirect: SetupReadController redirects only to the fixed local landing path / when authoritative setup status is complete; caller redirect targets are ignored.
laravel_adaptation.scope_boundary: POST /setup and DatabaseSetupService.RenderPage are separate canonical operations and are not claimed by this evidence.

security.route_parameters: The named GET route has zero route parameters and therefore exposes no tenant/resource direct-ID surface.
security.redirect_safety: A caller-supplied returnUrl such as https://evil.example/phish cannot alter the completed-install redirect, which remains exactly /.
security.secret_safety: Configured database passwords and connection strings are never rendered by the read endpoint; focused acceptance injects a sentinel password and proves it is absent from the response.
security.truthfulness: Database unreachable, missing migration ledger entries, or missing first identity keep setup incomplete rather than fabricating readiness.

proofs: exact canonical operation ID is linked to the real named GET route
route resolves to SetupReadController with web-only middleware and zero parameters
migrations without first identity remain incomplete
incomplete rendering omits a configured secret sentinel
completed setup ignores external caller redirect input and redirects only to /
